notes.title: Mini Patch 1
notes.notes:
Improvements to the surfing mini-game include: changing the maximum speed the player can travel, lighting in the beach scene, and increasing the speed of the animation on the waves.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41338565/4dc9057bc4de84ec3b374e2b16a68631ef854d46.png

The player can now use whichever control system they would prefer in the fishing mini-game. Previously, if a controller was available, the fishing game would default to using that and the player could not use a keyboard or mouse. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41338565/44d027101e87fa9914800a1a31befa6cbe7a38f3.png

Auto Follow Camera added as an option, accessible in the Controls screen.

Fixing clipping bugs while walking over sand dunes. 

The save system displays the last used to save the profile first. 

If you have any more problems, make sure to let us know!
